witnesses.query: SELECT COUNT(entity_id) AS n FROM MEASURE activity IN qlperf ON (hot) STAGES TIME BETWEEN '2026-10-16T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-29T01:00:00Z'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) AS n FROM MEASURE activity IN qlperf ON (hot) STAGES TIME BETWEEN '2026-10-16T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-29T01:00:00Z'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) AS n FROM MEASURE activity IN qlperf ON (warm) STAGES TIME BETWEEN '2026-10-16T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-29T01:00:00Z'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) AS n FROM MEASURE activity IN qlperf ON (cold) STAGES TIME BETWEEN '2026-10-16T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-29T01:00:00Z'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) AS n FROM MEASURE activity IN qlperf ON (hot,warm) STAGES TIME BETWEEN '2026-10-16T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-29T01:00:00Z'
